data.name: O2Jam : The Beginning
data.detailed_description:
The core of a music game is "Music" itself.

O2Jam: The Beginning is the legendary rhythm game series chosen by 200 million users worldwide over the past 22 years. Experience high-quality original tracks produced exclusively for rhythm games and an overwhelming note impact right here on Steam with the official O2Jam rhythm game.

Key Features

  • Optimized Play Environment & Customization

    Wide Difficulty Range: Level design that satisfies everyone from beginners to hardcore maniacs.

    Various Key Modes: Supports 3K, 4K, 5K, and more.

    Flexible Key Settings: Supports a key change system tailored to player convenience.

  • Global Comprehensive Ranking System

    Compete with users worldwide and challenge for the TOP class through national and global rankings.

  • Sequential Expansion of All O2Jam Series Songs

    Perfectly ported O2Jam masterpieces like 'V3', 'The Festival of Ghost', and 'A Christmas Memory (Origin)'!

    Includes songs by world-class rhythm game artists such as BeautifulDay, Brandy, Studio Doma, SHK, Pory, S.I.D Sound, and Memme.

    New songs from rising rhythm game stars are constantly updated, with the library expanding continuously until the official release.

data.short_description: O2Jam : The Beginning is the official PC version based on O2Jam - Music & Game, featuring the entire series collection. Enjoy legendary original tracks, overwhelming note impact, and various key modes! From nostalgic classics to new hits, experience the authentic rhythm action of O2Jam.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Arabic, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent AMD
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 / AMD Radeon HD 6570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio Compatible
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 Integrated Graphics or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio Compatible
